versions.changelog:
- Initial public release with code and documentation.
- Adds video analysis script supporting YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram.
- Supports frame extraction, transcript generation (captions or Whisper), and Markdown output.
- Includes setup scripts, usage examples, and troubleshooting guidance.
- Updated model references to current Claude model naming.
- Renamed and improved documentation files (expanded README, replaced skill-card.md).

Initial release of video-to-markdown: Turns any YouTube, Facebook, or Instagram video into a detailed Markdown reference by analyzing visuals and transcripts.

- Converts videos into structured Markdown documents, capturing both spoken and visual content.
- Supports YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook URLs; handles cookies where required.
- Offers flexible frame extraction, transcript options (captions/Whisper), and model selection for cost/quality tradeoffs.
- Useful command-line interface with step-by-step usage and troubleshooting included.
- Output includes YAML metadata, breakdown by section, key visuals, and narration–visual gaps.
